name: mindtrace
description: MINDTRACE: The City That Lies — a browser-based 3D detective game

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend test
